description_en:
At Al-Muslim Group, we are dedicated to operating a sustainable business that achieves commercial success while being socially empowering and environmentally responsible. We prioritize creating a safe and healthy workplace for our employees and fostering a culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and personal growth. Our commitment to treating all employees with dignity and respect ensures a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and victimization.


We adhere to both local and international labor laws, follow International Labour Organization (ILO) guidelines, and comply with Brand/Buyer’s Codes of Conduct in our employee relations. Our vision is to become a leading manufacturer of woven garments for global fashion brands, driven by our dedication to social and corporate responsibility.


Our Compliance team ensures adherence to all relevant regulations, codes, policies, and procedures. We are committed to protecting the environment by minimizing the environmental impact of our products and operations, focusing on reducing natural resource consumption through advanced technologies. Our robust compliance governance system supports the implementation and enhancement of internal controls, promoting an ethical work environment and contributing effectively to our mission.


We believe in progressing together with our society and workers. This philosophy underscores our responsibility towards our employees and the community through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives that exceed legal requirements.

description_en:
Al-Muslim Group, an apparel manufacturer based in Bangladesh, stands as a leading global provider of readymade garments and denim products. Renowned as one of the premier garment manufacturing organizations in Bangladesh, we specialize in creating stylish and fashionable readymade garments and denim items. With a comprehensive and up-to-date manufacturing system and machinery setup, Al-Muslim Group is committed to maintaining quality standards in compliance with national and international laws.

We produce a diverse range of woven top and bottom items for men, women, and children. Upholding a commitment to quality and timely delivery, we thrive on overcoming challenges. Customer satisfaction is paramount, and the competent team ensures a final inspection on behalf of clients, reinforcing the company's reputation.

Al-Muslim Group has earned recognition in the readymade garment industry in both Asia and Europe, attributing its success to massive production capacity, advanced technologies, skilled team members, and a dedicated focus on customer satisfaction. With a workforce of 16,000 employees considered a valuable asset, we manufacture over 4.5 million pieces of various readymade garments monthly, catering to all age groups.

The annual turnover surpasses $200 million, showcasing our financial strength. In addition to readymade garments, Al-Muslim Group extends its services to produce garment accessories, offer embroidery and printing facilities, and provide garment washing services for customers. The in-house facilities are strategically designed to ensure the highest quality, competitive prices, and top-notch services for valued customers.

Our in-house facilities are strategically crafted to ensure the highest quality, competitive pricing, and excellent services, aiming to satisfy our esteemed customers. Ultimately, our mission is to stand out as a symbol of excellence in the apparel industry, fueled by innovation, quality, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.

description_en:
Al Muslim Group is a distinguished leader in the apparel industry. As part of our unwavering commitment to transparency, ethical practices, and social responsibility, we undergo a range of comprehensive Social Audits conducted by reputable organizations and brands.


Among these audits, we proudly engage with Betterwork, a globally recognized entity dedicated to promoting fair labor practices and sustainable working conditions. The collaboration with Betterwork underscores our dedication to meeting and exceeding international standards for social compliance in the manufacturing sector.


In addition to Betterwork, we subject ourselves to various other types of Social Audits conducted by esteemed brands such as Bestseller, C&A, Kontoor, NEXT, Twins Asia, and Inditex. These audits serve as a testament to our commitment to upholding the highest industry standards endorsed by some of the most influential names in the fashion and retail sector.


Our participation in these audits reflects our proactive approach to ensuring our manufacturing processes align seamlessly with the stringent social and ethical criteria set forth by industry leaders. Through these engagements, we continuously strive to create a work environment that not only meets regulatory requirements but also goes beyond to promote fair labor practices and sustainable business operations.


At Al Muslim Group, we recognize the importance of accountability and adherence to global standards. Our collaboration with renowned brands and participation in various Social Audits exemplify our dedication to fostering an industry that values ethical practices, social responsibility, and sustainability.

description_en:
To drive sustainability across our production processes, we have invested in the most advanced washing and dyeing machines that drastically reduce water and energy usage.

Our hi-tech dyeing machines are equipped with features like Airflow dyeing, Pressure dyeing, and Soft Flow dyeing that require significantly less water and chemicals compared to conventional dyeing systems. This results in over 50% savings in resource consumption.

Our washing machines also utilize cutting-edge control systems to digitally optimize the wash cycles, reducing processing times, water utilization and power consumption by over 40%.

Additionally, heat recovery systems in these machines recapture heat energy that is then reused for heating water. This improves energy efficiency and lowers our carbon footprint.

By adopting the latest water and energy-efficient dyeing and washing technologies, we aim to lower resource usage, wastage generation and carbon emissions from these processes. Our capital investments in such green machines reflect our commitment to embedding sustainability across all aspects of apparel manufacturing.

description_en:
At Al-Muslim Group, we are dedicated to operating a sustainable business that achieves commercial success while being socially empowering and environmentally responsible. We prioritize creating a safe and healthy workplace for our employees and fostering a culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and personal growth. Our commitment to treating all employees with dignity and respect ensures a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and victimization.

We adhere to both local and international labor laws, follow International Labour Organization (ILO) guidelines, and comply with Brand/Buyer’s Codes of Conduct in our employee relations. Our vision is to become a leading manufacturer of woven garments for global fashion brands, driven by our dedication to social and corporate responsibility.
